description: Parameters consumed by signing stages. SIGN_ARTIFACTS is defined here and referenced via stageCondition by stages 06-post-build-code-sign, 08-code-sign-installer, 09-sbom-sign, 10-digital-artifact-sign, and 11-verify-signing. Vendor overrides may suppress, replace, or extend these via a vendor-scripts/03-internal-code-sign.params.json in the config repo.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: SIGN_ARTIFACTS
parameters.description: Enable artifact signing stages (internal code sign, post-build code sign, installer signing, SBOM signing, GPG digital artifact signing, and signature verification). Disabled by default — enable for release and weekly builds that require signed artifacts.
